title: Polling loop without visibility or lifecycle controls
summary: Frontend framework code polls APIs continuously even when the tab is hidden or data is unchanged.
rationale: Polling creates repeated network, server, and client work that scales with active users.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Use event-driven updates, backoff, visibility checks, caching, and stale-while-revalidate patterns.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
